summary: Info Sheet #59 Audit / Transparency Engine tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests PASSED (audit/me shape+mutation logging, export bundle, consent registry incl. invalid input 400, admin query+filters, analytics shape, user trail, rapid-delete + data-export alerts firing, alert resolve incl. 404-if-already-resolved, delete-project regression owner=200 / non-owner=404). Frontend: demo_home Profile → Privacy & Activity opens /privacy showing 5 consent switches (marketing/analytics/cookies/data_processing/personalization), data-use chips (Projects=41, Privacy=10, Data-rights=3), Export button, and a 54-item activity feed with risk dots. Admin AuditModule at /admin -> 'Audit & Transparency' shows Event Log (69 events, search 'projects' filters to 42), Analytics (category bars + by-risk stats + top actors), and Alerts (3) with working Mark-resolved (3→2 and badge updated).

issues: Cosmetic only: MaterialCommunityIcons warning 'home-heart-outline is not a valid icon name' printed from Profile — pre-existing; unrelated to Sheet #59.

critical_code_review_comments: audit_engine.py is well-scoped (~380 lines) and correctly isolated from server.py.
Middleware skips /api/audit* and /api/admin/audit* to avoid recursion — good.
log_event() swallows insert errors so audit failures never break the request path — good.
Consent state derives 'latest per type' via in-memory reduce; fine at small scale, could switch to indexed sort/limit if consent_registry grows large.
Frontend privacy.tsx uses optimistic UI on consent toggle and reverts + re-loads on failure — good UX.
seed_data_creation: Created ~10 TEST_ projects on demo_home for rapid-delete alert test; all deleted at end of test. A few TEST_ audit events + consent rows remain in DB (expected — audit trail is append-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login button label is 'LOG IN' (not 'Sign in'). Use input[type=email] / input[type=password] then click 'LOG IN'. React Native Switch on web doesn't expose aria-checked reliably — verify consent toggle state via /api/consents rather than DOM attributes.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All 10 review-request bullets verified green: (1) auto-audit middleware ✓ (2) /audit/me/export ✓ (3) 5 consent types + 400 on invalid ✓ (4) admin filters + 403 for non-admin ✓ (5) analytics shape ✓ (6) rapid_resource_delete + data_export alerts + resolve 404-if-already ✓ (7) /admin/audit/user/{id} trail ✓ (8) /privacy screen with consent-*, privacy-export, activity-row ✓ (9) /admin AuditModule with 3 tabs, search, resolve ✓ (10) DELETE /projects owner=200 non-owner=404 regression ✓.
